name: Kling AI: Kling V2.1
description: Kling 2.1 is Kuaishou's advanced image-to-video model (2025). It transforms reference images (and optional text) into high-definition cinematic videos using a 3D spatiotemporal attention architecture. The model simulates real-world physics and delivers very natural, intricate motion and lifelike characters. It can produce multiple video variants from the same prompt and uses AI-assisted prompting to help users craft detailed instructions. In comparative tests, Kling 2.1 rivals top closed-source competitors. Overall, it marks a significant step up in realism, coherence, and prompt-following over Kling 2.0.
